#define CTVAL(target,func) {			\ /* <=== camlibs/ptp2/ptp-pack.c:735:740:CTVAL:2 */ 
	if (total - *offset < sizeof(target))	\
		return 0;			\
	target = func(&data[*offset]);		\
	*offset += sizeof(target);		\
}
